verses.text: Mamin Jehová, ab' in lesal, cham wal ab'an tas swala'. Tak'wanh t'ayin, ina to te tojol ach, tzak'annhejelk'och tas tzala'.
Manh a k'anb'ej tas waj a in a chekab' in tik, yujto malaj junok mach wach' yaj t'a a sat.
Ix in pechji b'eyek' yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ix in stek'anem heb' t'a sat lu'um. Ix in yak' kajnaj heb' t'a skal k'ik' k'inal, icha wal yaj heb' chamnakxo.
Manhxo anima'ok waj tikne'ik swab'i, te somchajnak in k'o'ol.
Tzin nakot juntzanh k'uhal ek'nak t'a peka', tzin na'ub'tanhan masanil tas a b'onak t'a yalanhtax chi'.
Ha t'ayach tzin mojb'ejk'e in k'ab', tzach in nib'ej wal, icha wal junok lum takinh lu'um snib'an ha ha'.
Mamin Jehová, tak'wanh t'ayin t'a elanhchamel, toxo wal tz'el in k'ol swab'i. Manh a ya'ej a kolwal t'ayin. Icha wal heb' chamnak smukchajemi, icham chi' ol in ajok tato tza ya'ej a kolwal t'ayin.
Ak' in nakot a wach'k'olal t'a junjun k'inhib'alil, ina to a ach tzach wak'och yipok in k'o'ol. Ch'ox t'ayin tas ol aj in b'eyb'ati, yujto wan in lesalwi t'ayach.
Mamin Jehová, kolinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol, yujto a t'ayach tzin say in kolnab'il.
k'ayb'ej in yik tzin b'o icha tas tza nib'ej, yujto in Diosal ach. A'okab' Espíritu wach' tzin ik'an b'ey t'a a wach' b'eyb'al.
Mamin, manh in a cha chamok, yik wach' max alchaj chukal lolonel t'ayach. Ik' in elta t'a skal wilk'olal, yujto wach' ach toni.
Yuj a wach'k'olal t'ayin, yuj chi' tza satkanel masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, yujto a chekab' in.
